notes.title: 02/06/2025 Steam Leaderboards (+ some old news - Sorting Table, Challenge mode)
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I decided to focus on some single-player content in the recent updates! (For when your friends aren't around)

[h2]Global Leaderboards + Friend leaderboards[/h2]

When you finish a run in time trials, you can now compare your time to your friends' and the world's! (So basically, tell your friends about this game and see if you can beat their time! Or try and break the world record?)

The screenshot above looks a bit weird because I am the only one who has submitted a time, so please help and play some time trials!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/9d9ac77da1a845581353de1ce5bf3f0e39e29fc7.png[/img]

[h2]Old news[/h2]

There were some updates which I have pushed but didn't really introduce previously.

[h3]Challenge mode[/h3]

This was a mode to see if you can beat the demo, but now I've also put it in the full game. (Think Grand Prix on Mario Kart.) More challenges will come, but for now see if you can get the secret 3-star rank!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/43cfc80e7b0676994309ccf0e60b312b2583fa41.png[/img]

[h3]Sorting table[/h3]

I added a new table where there are two pockets that switch every few seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/cf866add4c256eec14bc6ea5d99108d65b3b5592.gif[/img]

You have to pot the ball in the correct hole. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/ab7dce9e55a30c3fc66586ac6e1d97e0f99fc39e.gif[/img]

If you pot the ball in the wrong hole, it will respawn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/9b760e9593c0818be630f2103884f9a5ac6da035.gif[/img]

That's all for now, 
See ya in the next one!

Felix

notes.title: 02/12/2024 Time Trial mode added! (Game released and new trailer)
notes.content:
Hey, hey!

I've just realised I never wrote an update about the game releasing... :P

Well, the game has released, so you can play the full game now!

On top of that we have:

[h2]Cover art[/h2]

We have new cover art by Felipe! If you love his art like me, go check him out [url=https://www.instagram.com/felips.psd/]here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/4ee7be1d04ae921e53e6e9b8559ba0eebf147176.png[/img]

[h2]Time Trial mode[/h2]

You can race yourself to beat the computer in 1v1 and 4 players! Compare your times with yourself, your friends, and me! (I'll probably put my times as Steam achievements or something.)

Here's my best time. 0:38.636 Try and beat it and let me know in the comments if you did or not!

[previewyoutube=aRQqqPruDME;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]New Trialer[/h2]

I got some fun reaction shots at Comic-con X EGX this year. Here is the (old) new launch trailer!

[previewyoutube=i7_Fqt3Rj-s;full][/previewyoutube]

That's it from me; I'll probably try the remainder of the maps soon!

Felix

Also Bug fixes:
- Football table when a ball is sunk, show the rays of light correctly.
- Hippo table, when a hippo eats a ball, the correct light, lights up.

notes.title: 30/09/2024 This week's updates!
notes.content:
Hey, hey! This week I did some game updates but mainly focused on spicing up the store page, getting ready for Steam Next Fest!

[h1]Store Updates[/h1]

[h2]Art[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/537e82334ff91aa807b239c79790d8ad3eb8250f.png[/img]

I thought the cover didn't reflect the fun and silliness of Pool 2, so I added some characters to it! (Hopefully this will encourage more people to check the game out!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/b9ea012bb30008846e05291962afa903d92df19d.png[/img]

Here are my initial sketches. I'm a beginner illustrator, but I'm happy with what I drew... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/9fcab81cead3b286359c109e6486442d54eec8fb.png[/img]

[h2]Trailer[/h2]

I also made a new trailer showing off the game and the new tables! Check it out!

[previewyoutube=Q4lX9yEdhdA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Game Updates[/h1]

- You can now press Square (Playstation) or X (Xbox / Gamepad) to softly nudge the ball to set up a shot! (Some people before found it hard to hit the ball softly.)
- The river table flows now slows down much faster. (It slows down roughly 25x quicker than before!)

That's it for this week! See you later!

Felix!

notes.title: New tables and improvements on existing tables!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I've got some new tables and some updated tables!

[h1]Updated tables![/h1]

[h2]Football table[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/204dbee4ca9e583a615d134fa84806a2d1c38735.gif[/img]

- Added a slope at the end and of the corner of the pitch. (This is so that your balls don't stick to the edge and it's not fun.)
- Made the football crowd cheer when a goal is scored!
- Fixed the collision between the balls and the goal keeper (so the balls actually bounce off instead of sliding off.)


[h2]Radar table[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/183aaec8b9dffc532433fc03ab2219efb2fb8e4f.gif[/img]

- Added some background stuff to make the table look nicer. 
- Fixed a bug where the balls would slow down on the outer ring of the table
- Added some colour to the radar itself so you can see the black ball properly


I also added the slope to the donut table too, but it visually looks the same.

You can play all of these updated tables in the demo!


[h1]New tables![/h1]

[h2]River table[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/1b47be06dc0daaf749fe988052eb94bc1e0f0022.gif[/img]

Play against the current of a river!


[h2]Sushi table[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/f9c60db82106cd246870f6cbbe24f496f2cb5aff.gif[/img]

Play on a conveyor belt sushi table!


[h2]Hippo table[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/5fd217e4624f16e61999ae38c2b6da6fed8396c1.gif[/img]

Throwback to the a certain game from my childhood!


[h2]DVD table[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/5d864beb6b615e22e6cafe5bde821f8ed4df7877.gif[/img]

Play with 90s energy while the hole moves and bounces around the table


These tables will appear in the full game! 

That's it! Thanks for reading! Until next time!

Felix

notes.content:

Do you have any ideas for tables? Let me know in the comments!

Felix

notes.title: Big Update: Beta Build is live!
notes.content:
Hey, hey. First post!  I'm Felix and I'm the developer of Pool 2! 

For those who don't know, Pool 2 is a game where it's like normal Pool but each player has a cue ball and you can shoot whenever you want, so no more waiting for your turn!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/7eccf94b05e503a0ad66ca81ecffe7cd41e313a7.gif[/img]

Over the past month, I've been working hard.  I want to talk about the 3 main things I've worked on.


[h1]The new look![/h1]

This is Pool 2 the comparison between last month and now:

Game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/28768f7340d19c4f090223ad41953246e99bac59.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/58da031ffe1571edd90752275859c120bd83c23b.png[/img]

Title Screen:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/d3bc52c9498d3080b75bd8a7d1db93defab59cc5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/07812df045d549ef226f4fb6676c3baea68453e1.png[/img]

Really big improvement! (I would like to hope...)


[h1]New trailer[/h1]

With the new look comes new store screenshots and trailers so, check it out!

https://youtu.be/bNwu3qtLTU4?si=haxzOsvwGkCHs-Vi


[h1]Colour blind mode[/h1]

Imagine if you're colour blind and you can't play Pool 2. That would suck. Until the last update that is what would happen if you can't see colour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/d8963013fb784f2f9d3b3f917bdb0d62ebf3a92a.png[/img]

Now you can enable colour blind mode in the settings and it will look like this: 

(For people who can't see colour)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/994c6745d65c43c9cbbd41886c21c139bf7e89b2.png[/img]

For people who can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/b7810a3db9d73e94d51bb6905c2a52803c1b0486.png[/img]

I'm not sure if I know people who are colour blind so if you're actually colour blind do let me know if you can see which balls belong to which group in the comments!


There's a lot more smaller features that I coded over the last month but I'll let you guys find them. I'm going to try and put a demo that stays on this page so you guys can try the game out!

Thanks for reading,

Felix
